page.layout: One scanned image of a closed book in its vellum or leather binding, seen from the front cover. No printed text block is visible. Only the spine at the left edge carries a faded printed label with a few illegible letters.
page.notes: Front board of a bound book, not a printed page. The spine label at the left edge shows only fragments of a faded title (partly legible, e.g. "...delen"), too incomplete to transcribe reliably. Dark background, binding stains, worm or wear marks, and a pair of stitch or lacing marks are not printed text and are omitted.
